crossRefs.note: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

people.name: Bavvai
people.line: A leader who helped repair Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Henadad
people.line: Son of Binnui, a Levite who repaired the wall.

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

translations.web: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.
translations.bsb: Next to him, their countrymen made repairs under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.
translations.kjv: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
translations.asv: After him repaired their brethren, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah.
